title: Copied retained centers and two-stage assembly for conditional kappa = 3.84569e-5
body:
This extends [PR #32](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/32) at `0ef3aeb61f55cc0b321ce6a0ef00acee25cefe52` with one new commit, retaining the #10 → #18 → #24 → #32 ancestry. It also adopts the attributed two-stage and corner contributions from Paureel and PR #29/#31/#33, alongside the retained PR #21, PR #23 and RaD interfaces described below.

Under the retained multiplication framework and those analytic/tape interfaces,

$$
T(n)=O\!\left(n(\log n)^{1-\kappa}\right),\qquad
\kappa=\frac{384569}{10000000000}=3.84569\times10^{-5}.
$$

## Construction

The copied retained-center schedule supplies each scatter from a transformed copy while the original role proceeds directly to cleanup. In both invocation orientations, the charged ranks change from `(r,h)` to `(r,h-r)`, preserving scalar actions and auxiliary endpoints. This reduces the two-stage rank budget from `Wm-N+2L` to `Wm-N+L`. The rank-`r` copy and the separate rank-one endpoint correction remain fully charged.

The bit network uses `(25,23)`, retaining the verified producers, positive labels and compatible carrier assignment. The PR #31 corner method, parameterized in PR #33, gives the data profile `11 singletons; 21,15,481`. Its 47 rational pivots and 315 weight-independent zero-minor certificates support the contiguous blocks in one controlled basis.

The complex network uses `(28,28)` with mixed dyadic centers and disjoint-center count 19. The copied-center schedule transfers to forward/inverse phase residuals. The two-stage endpoint uses a paid inverse phase on a copy and fixed sign corrections, with the translated auxiliary endpoints preserved.

The strict component savings are `384599/10000000000` (bit) and `717/10000000` (complex). Their certified moment gaps exceed `2.10899506e-12` and `8.52696172e-9`, respectively.

The assembly adapts **Zhihao Chen (jacklightChen)**'s PR #23 composition of **RaD (hipotures)**'s completed-child semantic precision, arbitrary-coordinate routing, phase-cell Gaussian inverse and bulk resampling. Translated complex endpoints follow Zhihao Chen's PR #21. The actual scalar gate charge includes the copied centers and gives `C1=1`; nested adapters pay the product of both row stocks, bounded by `p^2000`. All 47 strict constraints and seven assembly margins hold, with final absorption gap greater than `4.0746e-11`.

## Contribution sources and prior PRs

My preceding contributions under **icekylinx** form the direct implementation lineage:

| [#18](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/18) | Partial-swap frames and removal of the source rank penalty; binary retained totals, compatible carrier reuse and positive frames; selected `(25,23,57)` basis. | `1.884586e-6` |
| [#24](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/24) | Complementary auxiliary endpoint gauges, selected `(32,30,40)` basis, general nondegenerate binary phase residuals and updated precision guard. | `5.98615e-6` |
| [#32](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/32) | A1/A5 block refinements, fixed `I+J` middle-axis profiles certified by bounded-minor CRT, mixed low-loss complex centers, complete data-front batching and instantiation of the attributed semantic/bulk assembly. | `1.2523415e-5` |
| This PR | Copied retained-center scheduling in both orientations, two-stage complex endpoint transfer, selected `(25,23)`/`(28,28)` networks and instantiation of the attributed semantic/bulk assembly. | `3.84569e-5` |

Baker–Harman–Pintz supplies the prime-interval theorem used by the adopted packing argument. Historical AI-assistance disclosures are preserved. The table records construction dependencies and contribution scope; independently published exponent savings are not added together.

## Proof and attribution

- `notes/copied-centers-note.tex`: selected construction and assembly, supplied as LaTeX source.
- `scripts/copied_centers_producer.py`: new producer and exact corner reconstruction.
- `certificates/copied-centers-network.json`: recursive moments, rank budgets, semantic precision, row accounting and assembly.
- `references/copied-centers/` and `references/semantic-bulk/`: necessary pinned proof sources, original notices and licenses.

The result remains conditional on the retained analytic/tape interfaces, constructive setup and eventual thresholds. Finite checks do not formally verify the complete theorem. The inherited `patches/batched-23.patch` remains the #10 baseline; this extension is presented in its standalone proof.

The new copied-center schedule, complex transfer and selected composition are contributed by **icekylinx**, with substantial OpenAI GPT-6 Astra and Codex assistance. Original attribution is retained, including Paureel at `c82d09eb4781b68435e3fa3eb6beea72fa900fab`, PR #29 at `9d963275075fa98f1da821e27757b238dafd6b3c`, the PR #31 method at `02f68f95369c39955c5ffcfddbd75cd83e26b305`, and PR #33 at `a499a345c040aa15b68e984a0904eadc485c7a7e`. The retained PR #21/#23 and RaD sources remain pinned in `SOURCES.json`. The repository retains Apache-2.0; imported RaD sources retain CC0. Exploratory variants, duplicate snapshots and large raw graph dumps are excluded.

## Validation

- Matched the unchanged h25/h23 bit producer counts and histograms to their previously verified certificate.
- Recomputed all 47 rational pivots and verified all 315 zero-minor partitions by 630 exact integer-rank calculations. The complete corner profile matches the selected certificate.
- Rebuilt the new h28d19 mixed-center complex producer and matched every carrier count and histogram entry; exact scalar and frame checks passed.
- Reconstructed both child lists and certified their moments, copied-center rank budgets, semantic induction, product row reserves, 47 strict constraints and seven assembly margins.
- Checked the final source diff for whitespace errors. Proof sources are included; no PDF compilation was performed this round.

Unchanged previous-round producer and regression checks were not rerun.
